notes.title: More Demo Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We updated the Okko The Exiled Demo... AGAIN! With just under a month left to play it, we wanted to polish up a few extra things. [/p][p]Worth noting– bigger updates/changes related to core gameplay, accessibility, etc., will not appear in the demo, as those updates will take longer and have broader effects on the development of the game. Meaning, if there are any more demo updates before the end of July, they'll also be small. [/p][p]The Patch Notes for this update are as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Added new sound effects for the Mushroom Enemy. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an animation sync issue with the mercenaries in The Old Throne. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a Gem Counter UI issue related to looting small gems right after looting a big gem. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a Gem Counter UI issue where Okko's gem UI would not update properly after spending money at the shops. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a gameplay/UI bug combo that would allow Okko to buy potions even if he already had the max amount (2 of each) in his inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an audio bug that would cause Okko's "surface landing" sound to play when jumping up through one-way platforms. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo in the tutorial dialogue. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug related to "Gem Burn" sounds / gem counting not behaving properly when opening/closing the Inventory. [/p][/*][/list][p]That's all for now! As always, thank you for your continued support and interest in the game! 

–FFI Team[/p]

notes.title: Audio Remix And Small Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone! 

We patched the demo again! This time our focus was on audio and small bug fixes.[/p][p]Patch Notes:[/p][list][*][p]Remixed sound design. The demo's sound design has been completely remixed, so it should sound more balanced and professional compared to previous builds. [/p][/*][*][p]Okko's "knock-back" when hitting enemies and other objects has been cut in half. This should make combo-ing easier. We'll keep an eye out for additional feedback regarding this. We wanted to lower the knock-back amount before potentially getting rid of it entirely, because we like how it adds a sense of weight to Okko's attacks. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed small miscellaneous bugs. 
[/p][/*][/list][p]Additional info on the demo's sound:[/p][p]Currently, the demo's sound effects are a fusion of "final" and "temporary" sounds. As some of you might be aware, our sound designer (who also composes Okko's soundtrack) only recently joined the team in the Sound Designer position. Because of this, we haven't had a proper amount of time to create entirely new sounds for the game, which will ultimately replace any temporary/placeholder sounds we have in the demo.[/p][p][/p][p]That's it for now! Thanks as always![/p][p][/p][p]— FFI Team[/p]

notes.title: Controls Update and Small Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This is a small QOL update of sorts. 

The Patch Notes are as follows:

[list]
[*] Gamepad [Left Analogue Stick] now works for game menus. (Previously it only worked for Okko's movement). 
[*] When playing on a gamepad, [D*Pad Up] and/or [Left Analogue Stick Up] are now used to "Interact" with NPCs and the Checkpoints (when using the Checkpoints to access the World Map.) This is to further prevent players from accidentally firing off projectiles when interacting with those types of objects in the game world. 
[*] Added an extra Bounce-Skull to Level 2, to make one of the jumps easier. 
[*] Adjusted the height of a couple of moving platforms that hover above the water in Level 1, to prevent an audio bug that happened if Okko repeatedly scraped against the top of the moving platform. 
[*] Extended the ground in an early-ish part of Level 1 to make the jump more fair. (Prior to this update, you almost had to rely on "Coyote Time" to pull off the jump, which wasn't the intent.)
[/list]
That's all for this update!

Thanks as always!

— FFI Team

notes.title: Okko Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We spent the day fixing up some core elements of the demo gameplay based on everyone's feedback. 

Unfortunately, due to reasons outside our control, we ended up with a temporary "lock" on our SteamWorks account, so we can't upload the build until someone from Steam works through a solution with us.

We're super excited to get this update in your hands, as it fixes a handful of core complaints from players! 

The demo's next patch will include:
[list]
[*] Improved Bounce-Attack! You'll now initiate the bounce-attack by simply pressing Down on the D*Pad or Down on the Left Analogue Stick. The attack's animation is snappier too, which makes Okko's attack hitbox appear much sooner than before.
[*] Left Analogue Stick can now be used to control Okko's movement. For now, you'll still be using the D*Pad for the menus, but this update should alleviate some of that D*pad fatigue. 
[*] Fixed a bug where, when buying items from Mongravis, Okko's UI gem count wouldn't update when the player exited the shop. 
[*] Replaced the "$" symbol in Mongravis' shop with the proper gem icon. 
[*] Made it so now Okko can't fire Projectiles in The Old Throne, to prevent him from accidentally firing them off when talking to NPCs. (Theoretically this could still accidentally happen when talking to buried demons in the game world, so maybe we'll just map a different default button to "Interact" in the future.)
[*] Fixed some small audio bugs. 
[/list]
Thank you again for all the feedback and support these past couple of days! We'll get this new and improved build in your hands as soon as possible! These improvements really do make the game sooooo much better! 

— FFI Team

notes.title: Bounce-Attack Update In Progress!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Thanks for all the feedback and thoughts regarding the "Okko The Exiled Demo"!

While a lot of people are enjoying their time in Kutala, one thing is clear: [b]Okko's "bounce-attack" still needs some work![/b]

After reading all the comments, we've realized the issue is big enough to warrant another demo update, as we want everyone's experience with the game to be as fun and fluid as possible. 

We know there are other features people really want as well, like key binding options, an analog stick option, and other QOL features, and we promise we'll get to those in the full game! But right now, the bounce-attack is  going to be our focus, as bouncing is such a core pillar of the gameplay and movement system. 

Thanks again for the feedback, support, and helping us make Okko's journey the best it can be!

— FFI Team

notes.title: New Trailer and Press Release
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone! 

First off, thank you for Wishlisting Okko The Exiled! We're a small team (3 of us on the development side) and your support means the world! 

We wanted to share that Okko's publisher, EastAsiaSoft, put out an official Press Release about the game today, which contains some more information not found on the Steam page. 

Here's that Press Release for anyone interested:
[url=https://www.eastasiasoft.com/press/668/Pixel-art-action-platformer-Okko-The-Exiled-arrives-on-consoles-and-PC-in-late-2025]Okko The Exiled EAS Press Release[/url]

Also, as you might have already noticed, there's a new gameplay trailer for Okko The Exiled here on Steam! (It can also be found on YouTube, etc.) This new trailer replaces the "Combat Quicklook" trailer, as it has most of that trailer's footage and more, all wrapped in an exciting and more professional package. The new trailer also has updated sound effects, which are currently getting worked into the game!

Again, thank you for all the interest, Wishlists, and reposting/sharing on Twitter/X/Bluesky! Remember, you can find new Okko content on Twitter/X/Bluesky at least once a week, as we're doing #ScreenShotSaturday posts there!

We're excited for everyone to check out Okko's upcoming June Next Fest Demo, and we'll keep sharing more about the game as we get closer and closer to launch, so check back from time to time!

Happy Gaming! 

—FFI Team
